notes.title: New Aplication Released!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759056/1668efba8e45bf336624b1a29272385f0a84a1d4.png[/img]

"Spidus" is Officially Released Today!
The new character "Minesweeper" has also made their debut!
We’ve added achievements, and there’s a rumor that a new difficulty level has been introduced for AI battles.

Don’t miss out—come and give it a try!

The new app can be found at the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402140/SPEEDUS_SHEDDING_SPEED_CARD_PLUS/

Thank you for your continued support of "Spidus"!

notes.title: Bug Fixes ver.240918.0651
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SPEEDUS – SHEDDING SPEED CARD.
We have implemented the following updates in version.240918.0651
－－－－－－－－－－
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where descriptions were not displayed correctly in the deck editing screen.
Fixed a problem where card displays and descriptions would glitch when using the Chess skill.
Corrected the effect of the Chess skill "Promotion" on the QUEEN card:
Changed from: "8-9: Add 8 cards from the discard pile to the opponent's deck. No effect if discard pile is empty."
To: "8-9: Add 10 cards from the discard pile to the opponent's deck. No effect if discard pile is empty."
－－－－－－－－－－
Thank you for your continued support of SPEEDUS – SHEDDING SPEED CARD.

Let me know if you'd like any adjustments!

notes.title: English Support and Various Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Thank You for playing 『SPEEDUSーSHEDDING SPEED CARDー 』
We have made the following updates for ver.240829.2222
－－－－－－－－－－
ver.240829.2222
【Warning】
After performing an update, matching with the older version is not possible. We advise to always update to the newest version.
－－－－－－－－－－
New Features
・English Language support
・Changed Test Mode to Single Player Mode with varying difficulty
・Polished various effects and animations
・Added feature to examine skills and abilites during match
・Adjusted game balance
　‐Buffed all of Klondike's skill effects.
　‐Adjusted Klondike's maximum deck cost to 25.
　‐Nerfed Sichuan's [Roukai-Teki-Ittsui] skill effect.
　‐Adjusted Sichuan's maximum deck cost to 15.
－－－－－－－－－－
Bug Fixes
　
・Fixed issues where some effects are not displayed correctly.
・Fixed connectivity issues when Sichuan's [Roukai] based deck performs skill activation consecutively.
・Fixed issues where Klondike's skill did not activate correctly when [Mighty] and [Million Seven] is combined.
・Corrected incorrect texts in skill, ability, and character descriptions.
・Fixed issues of main menu animation not displaying correctly on SteamDeck.
－－－－－－－－－－
Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you continue to enjoy 『SPEEDUSーSHEDDING SPEED CARDー』!
